notes.title: Achievements! Italian! SALE?!
notes.content:
Ever since our beardy fellas received that honorable mention for [url=http://www.igf.com/finalists-and-winners]IGF's Excellence in Narrative[/url] award, they've been clamoring for some way to keep track of their achievements. And something about a quit button. Fine.

Today's update adds the following:
[list]
    [*]Achievements
    [*]Italian localization
    [*]Steam Controller config
    [*]Steam Cloud support
    [*]Quit button
    [*]Bug fixes and polish
[/list]

AND for the first time, Burly Men at Sea is 30% off!

*chaos of celebration*

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021311/88935249cfaacdcfc6c0ec2c2326d510d10de29d.gif[/img]
